remarks: Located in the highly sought-after "Behind the Y" neighborhood, this expanded and beautifully renovated 5-bedroom Colonial is truly move-in ready. Sited on 1.25 acres of flat, open land, the home offers three finished levels of thoughtfully designed living space. The renovated chef's kitchen features a breakfast bar, eat-in dining area, and opens seamlessly to the family room with custom built-ins-perfect for modern living and entertaining. The impressive addition boasts 9 ft ceilings, a vaulted great room with a striking fieldstone fireplace, a private study, and a stylish wet bar. French doors lead to a covered porch overlooking the professionally landscaped pool and terrace. The spacious primary suite includes two walk-in closets and a spa-like bath. Enjoy the perfect blend of indoor and outdoor living-all with sidewalks to town, Waveny Park, the YMCA, and top-rated schools.
